name: sortable-table
title: Sortable table
description: A table driven by a column list that sorts on header click, with aria-sort on the active header, a stable order, and text, numbers and dates each compared the right way.
docs: columns take key, header, align, sortType (text, number or date, or false for no sort), accessor and cell; a header cycles ascending, descending, off. Text is ordered by Intl.Collator for the locale with numbers in natural order, numbers and ISO dates by value, empty values are always last and equal rows keep their order. Only the sorted header has aria-sort, and a polite line says what changed. Use getRowId for stable keys, and sort (with onSortChange) or defaultSort. cell and accessor are functions, so render it from a client component. sort.ts has sortRows for sorting on the server.
